name: glass-pane
title: Glass Pane
description: OGL animated glass panel strips with refraction, chromatic aberration and wave distortion over an image.

usage.label: Astro
React
Svelte
usage.code:
<script>
  import "@/components/motion-kit/glass-pane-element.ts";
</script>

<motion-glass-pane
  image="/images/your-image.jpg"
  rotation={0}
  refraction={1}
  chromatic-aberration={1}
  panel-width={0.82}
  wave-frequency={0.0}
  wave-amplitude={0.0}
  speed={0.65}
  class="w-full h-[500px]"
/>

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-kit/glass-pane-element.js"></script>

<motion-glass-pane
  image="/images/your-image.jpg"
  rotation="0"
  refraction="1"
  chromatic-aberration="1"
  panel-width="0.82"
  wave-frequency="0.0"
  wave-amplitude="0.0"
  speed="0.65"
  class="w-full h-[500px]"
/>

props.name: image
props.description: URL of the background image to display through the glass pane.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Rotation angle of the glass strips in degrees.

props.name: refraction
props.description: Strength of the glass refraction distortion.

props.name: chromatic-aberration
props.description: Intensity of RGB color splitting at edges.

props.name: panel-width
props.description: Width of each glass strip as a fraction of the canvas.

props.name: wave-frequency
props.description: Frequency of the wave distortion across the strips.

props.name: wave-amplitude
props.description: Amplitude of the wave distortion effect.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed of the wave distortion.
